CustomField.formula: IF( AND(ISPICKVAL(Sell_Currency__c, "HKD"), BLANKVALUE(Sell_FX_Rate__c, 0) <= 0), NULL, IF(OR(ISBLANK(BLANKVALUE(Quantity_Delivered_Per_BDN__c, 0)), BLANKVALUE(Quantity_Delivered_Per_BDN__c, 0) = 0), BLANKVALUE(Quantity__c, 0) * IF(ISPICKVAL(Sell_Currency__c, "HKD"), BLANKVALUE(Sell_HKD_Unit_Price__c, 0) / Sell_FX_Rate__c, BLANKVALUE(Sell_USD_Unit_Price_Precise__c, BLANKVALUE(Unit_Sell_At__c, 0))), BLANKVALUE(Quantity_Delivered_Per_BDN__c, 0) * IF(ISPICKVAL(Sell_Currency__c, "HKD"), BLANKVALUE(Sell_HKD_Unit_Price__c, 0) / Sell_FX_Rate__c, BLANKVALUE(Sell_USD_Unit_Price_Precise__c, BLANKVALUE(Unit_Sell_At__c, 0)))) )
CustomField.label: Total Price
